title: Clouds and Sky Trails Above Alexandria
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 7:04 a.m., on my way to the Metro station for work, I noticed white aircraft trails crossing a blue morning sky above traffic lights and power lines. Rippled clouds, possibly altocumulus, were softly lit with gold and peach near the horizon.
subject: Photography of clouds; Sky; Morning; Sunlight; Streets
alt_text: Long white aircraft trails cross a blue morning sky beside rippled clouds tinged with gold, above an Alexandria intersection with traffic lights and cars.

title: Morning Sky at Fort Monroe
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 7:56 a.m., during a family walk at Fort Monroe, I stopped to capture sunlight breaking through large, billowing clouds, possibly cumulus. Their dark gray bases and bright edges contrasted with patches of blue sky, while sunlight shimmered across the water beyond the sandy beach and rocky shoreline.
subject: Sky; Photography of clouds; Sunlight; Morning; Beaches; Coasts
alt_text: Sunlight breaks through thick gray and white clouds above a beach at Fort Monroe, illuminating the water beyond a rocky breakwater and a foreground railing.

title: Pastel Skies Over I-40
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 5:08 p.m., while riding with my cousin, I photographed the sky from an overpass above I-40 in Raleigh, North Carolina. Broad patches of gray clouds, possibly stratocumulus, were tinged with pink and gold above the tree-lined highway, contrasting with the blue sky and warm orange glow near the horizon.
subject: Photography of clouds; Sky; Horizon; Sunlight; Highway 40 (U.S)
alt_text: Pink and gold clouds stretch across a blue sky above I-40 in Raleigh, with an orange glow near the horizon and traffic between dark tree lines.

title: Waves of Pink,Orange, and Blue  Above the Intersection
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 5:13 p.m., while heading home after my last DoorDash delivery in Durham, North Carolina, I photographed sweeping pink and orange clouds against a blue sky. The clouds, possibly a mix of layered stratocumulus and thin, wispy cirrus, glowed above a shopping center and intersection framed by traffic lights, power lines, and silhouetted trees.
subject: Sky; Photography of clouds; Streetscapes (Urban design)
alt_text: Sweeping pink, orange, and gray clouds fill the blue sky above a Durham shopping center and intersection, crossed by power lines and silhouetted traffic signals.

title: Clear Blue Skies Above the Rocky Shore
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 7:49 p.m., during a beach day with friends, I photographed the nearly cloudless blue sky as the sun began to set. A faint pink and lavender glow stretched along the horizon above calm water, while warm light touched the rocky breakwater beside the sandy shore.
subject: Sky; Beaches; Coasts; Horizon; James River (Va.)
alt_text: A nearly cloudless blue sky fades to pale pink above calm water, beachgoers, and a rocky breakwater beside a sandy beach.

title: Sunlit Clouds Over the Hampton Waterfront
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 4:09 p.m., while walking across a bridge to Hampton University’s homecoming festivities, I photographed the view of the Hampton marina. Bright sunlight shone above billowing clouds, possibly cumulus, with white tops and darker gray bases. The light shimmered across the water beneath sailboat masts, waterfront buildings, and the curving bridge.
subject: Photography of clouds; Sunlight; Clouds; Waterfronts; Marinas; Bridges;
alt_text: Bright sun shines above billowing white and gray clouds over the Hampton marina, casting a shimmering reflection across water bordered by sailboats, buildings, and bridges.

title: Golden Skies Above the Miami Skyline
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 7:13 p.m., during my first yacht ride in Miami, Florida, I photographed scattered, puffy clouds, possibly cumulus, above the distant city skyline. Golden sunlight warmed the blue sky and reflected across the gently rippling water. The outing celebrated my cousin’s high school graduation with family and friends, combining views of waterfront homes with time to relax and enjoy the scenery.
subject: Photography of clouds; Sunlight; Sky; Ocean waves; Buildings
alt_text: Small, scattered clouds float above Miami’s distant skyline as golden sunlight reflects on rippling water, with a yacht railing in the foreground.

title: A Rainbow Breaks Through Above The Road
creator: Daryan Lassiter
description: At 6:31 p.m., while traveling along Mercury Boulevard in Hampton after the rain stopped, I photographed a vivid rainbow against a pale blue-gray, cloud-covered sky. The clouds formed a broad, hazy layer above the street, while the wet pavement reflected light beneath traffic signals, passing vehicles, and roadside businesses.
subject: Sky; Photography of clouds; Rainbows; Rain and rainfall; Streets
alt_text: A rainbow rises diagonally through a pale blue-gray sky above Mercury Boulevard in Hampton, where cars travel along wet pavement beneath traffic lights.
